features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifting device for ice blocks, but it is not cordless, handheld, or battery-powered. It is suspended by rigid rods from a cross beam and powered by a motor via cables.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: A flexible or resilient flap 6 may be secured to the end and lateral walls of the chamber adjacent the lower margin thereof in order to provide a seal between the lifting-chamber and any block of ice with which it
features.note: The reference describes a flexible or resilient flap for sealing, but it is described as optional and not explicitly a 'lip' on a 'suction cup'. The primary sealing mechanism relies on melting the ice.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: The receiver 21 is also connected by a pipe 24 to a flexible hose connected with another pipe 2 1 on the cross beam 12. and thence to each of the vacuum receptacles by flexible hose 25.
features.note: The reference describes an air exhausting pump operated by a motor to create a vacuum, but the pump (22) and receiver (21) are mounted on a traveling crane, not within the rigid body of the individual vacuum receptacle.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference does not disclose any pressure sensor or means for monitoring the vacuum level in the sealed region.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or mechanism to alert when vacuum falls to a threshold.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning threshold or its definition.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or its persistence.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference describes a motor (18) powering the hoisting drum and another motor (23) powering the vacuum pump, but neither is described as a rechargeable battery integrated into the lifting device itself.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The device described is part of a larger hoisting apparatus, suspended from a cross beam, and connected to an external vacuum pump via hoses, making it neither single-hand portable nor self-contained without external connections.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum lifting device for ice blocks, which is the same broad area, but the specific implementation is very different, lacking key features like portability, integrated power, and warning systems.
